_description: Lab Order scenario — form payload for the 'Create Lab Order' form (Labs & Imaging → Create Lab Order on the Patient page, ?tab=lab_orders). _fields values are the option texts exactly as rendered (e.g. "Alfarabi (E-Order)") plus the due date, collection-by, the Lab Test Tom Select options to pick (one per test row — labTest for row 0, labTest2 for row 1 added via the Add button), and free-text fields. The form is not a modal — it renders on the tab with a Save button (wire:click="update").

_config._comment_targetPatient: The target patient identifier is NOT stored here — it is read from config/config.json (appointment.targetPatientIdentifier), the single source of truth shared by every appointment/order test.
_config._comment_dueDate: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD, filled into the dueDate text input (no datepicker interaction required).

_fields.comment: E2E test lab order — created by Playwright.
_fields.notes: Priority: routine. Please review results in 48h.
